manifest.name: dsh-md-html-render
manifest.description: DSH Markdown→HTML 渲染工具：模型工具 md_html_render 把 Markdown 渲染为独立样式化网页，可返回或写入磁盘。零依赖。

bundle.text:
# dsh-md-html-render bundle patch
#
# Installed via:
#   dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-md-html-render
#
# (or from a checkout: dsh plugin --profile <name> add ./dsh-md-html-render)
#
# The row registers the dynamic model Tool `md_html_render` on the Host: it
# renders any Markdown into a standalone, styled HTML document and can write
# the result to disk through the DSH `fs` service.
- insert:
    - id: md-html-render
      name: 'dsh-md-html-render'

readme.text:
**English** | [简体中文](#-已废弃--已并入-dsh-md-preview)

This plugin has been **merged into [`LeslieWylie/dsh-md-preview`](https://github.com/LeslieWylie/dsh-md-preview)**. This repository is archived and will receive no further updates.

> **About the names.** Since v0.3.0 the merged plugin publishes under the package
> name **`dsh-md-html-render`** — this repository's name — because the npm name
> `dsh-md-preview` was registered on 2026-08-17 by an unrelated project from a
> different author. The repository path and the package name therefore no longer
> match. The code is at `LeslieWylie/dsh-md-preview`; *this* repository is only
> the pre-merge history and is not that package. Installing `dsh-md-preview`
> from npm gets you the other author's project.

Two plugins in this account rendered Markdown: this one provided the model-facing `md_html_render` tool, and `dsh-md-preview` provided the web GUI preview drawer. They carried two copies of the same renderer, and those copies had drifted apart — the same document could come out differently depending on which one produced it.

They are now one plugin with one renderer behind both surfaces, with a test that fails the build if the two ever disagree again.

**This code also never worked as an installed package.** It called `harness.registerTool(...)`, a sandbox global that only exists for in-process dynamic plugins, so the package form could not load. The merged version uses the real `defineTool` contract and is covered by executing tests.
You get the tool in a headless profile exactly as before, plus the preview drawer if your profile has the web GUI. Two differences worth knowing:

- The tool description and generated page are now **English**, and the page no longer hardcodes `lang="zh"` or appends a generator footer. The [Chinese README](https://github.com/LeslieWylie/dsh-md-preview/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md) is maintained.
- Writes resolve through the session filesystem service, so `save_path` obeys the same sandbox policy as every other write instead of bypassing it.

---

本插件已**并入 [`LeslieWylie/dsh-md-preview`](https://github.com/LeslieWylie/dsh-md-preview)**。此仓库已归档，不再更新。

> **关于名字。** 自 v0.3.0 起，合并后的插件以 **`dsh-md-html-render`**——也就是本仓库的名字——作为包名发布，因为
> npm 上的 `dsh-md-preview` 已于 2026-08-17 被另一位作者的无关项目注册。于是仓库路径与包名不再一致：代码在
> `LeslieWylie/dsh-md-preview`，而**本仓库**尽管同名，只是合并前的历史，并不是那个包。从 npm 安装
> `dsh-md-preview` 得到的是别人的项目。

本账号下曾有两个插件都在渲染 Markdown：本仓库提供模型工具 `md_html_render`，`dsh-md-preview` 提供网页界面的预览抽屉。两者各带一份渲染器副本，且已经产生漂移——同一份文档由不同入口产出，结果可能不一致。

现在它们合并为一个插件、一套渲染器支撑两个入口，并有测试保证一旦再次出现分歧就直接构建失败。

**另外，这份代码作为安装包从来就没能跑起来。** 它调用了 `harness.registerTool(...)`——这是只在进程内动态插件里才存在的沙箱全局变量，因此包形态根本无法加载。合并后的版本改用了真正的 `defineTool` 契约，并有真实执行的测试覆盖。

- 工具描述与生成页面改为**英文**，页面不再硬编码 `lang="zh"`，也不再追加生成器署名页脚。[中文 README](https://github.com/LeslieWylie/dsh-md-preview/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md) 仍在维护。
- 写入统一经由会话文件服务解析，因此 `save_path` 会遵守与其他写操作相同的沙箱策略，而不再绕开它。
